AUDIT QUESTION: Batch 49 cycle 2 (verification). Cycle 1: no consensus defect (one nit, no fix needed).

Batch 49 = THE SPEAKERS IN THE DELIVERY TEXTS (orchestrator order 2026-11-13 '00:05' item 3: "Every pin carries, per segment, the SPEAKER'S NAME where the source's title/description names the guest ... with its evidence ... PBX wants to tag the right people when he posts ... Unknown speaker = say unknown, never guess.").
The builder seals a per-segment record in the pin: speaker = {name or "unknown", role, line, basis, why, people: [{name, role, line}], measured}. The pin rides into the run's PINNED_DECISION.json.
telegram.speaker_lines(run_dir) renders, per segment:
- "speaker <name>" with its role and evidence line, or "speaker unknown" with its why;
- then each person the source names, with its line, or "the source names nobody";
- each quoted line is cut to 140 characters with '...', each why to 120;
- the whole block is capped at SPEAKERS_MAX = 1200 characters, ending "- (truncated)";
- it returns [] for a pin without records.

review_texts (the review drop note) and publish_kit (the pass path's kit, before FIRST COMMENT) add the block under SPEAKERS_HEAD. Nothing else changes: no gate, no authorisation, no send logic.
FIND: anything a delivery could crash on, a speaker invented or upgraded, a note past TEXT_MAX, a test that does not test what it claims. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.

+SPEAKERS_HEAD = "SPEAKERS (for tags; the builder's sealed record, never a guess):"
+SPEAKERS_MAX = 1200          # the block's cap: a long record never pushes a note past TEXT_MAX
+
+
+def _cut(text, n):
+    text = str(text)
+    return text if len(text) <= n else text[:n - 3].rstrip() + "..."
+
+
+def speaker_lines(run_dir):
+    """Order '00:05' (3): each segment's speaker as the builder sealed it in the pin (PINNED_DECISION.json, pin
+    segments[i].speaker): a name with its evidence line, or 'unknown' with why; then the people the source's title /
+    description names, each with its line (PBX tags them when he posts). [] for a pin without speaker records."""
+    try:
+        with open(os.path.join(run_dir, "PINNED_DECISION.json")) as f:
+            segs = (json.load(f).get("pin") or {}).get("segments") or []
+    except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError):
+        return []
+    out = []
+    for i, seg in enumerate(segs):
+        sp = seg.get("speaker") if isinstance(seg, dict) else None
+        if not isinstance(sp, dict):
+            continue
+        name = str(sp.get("name") or "unknown")
+        known = name.lower() != "unknown"
+        line = f"- {'hook' if i == 0 else f'clip {i}'} ({seg.get('channel')}): speaker {name}"
+        if known:
+            line += (f" ({sp['role']})" if sp.get("role") else "") + (f', evidence: "{_cut(sp["line"], 140)}"'
+                                                                      if sp.get("line") else "")
+        elif sp.get("why"):
+            line += f" ({_cut(sp['why'], 120)})"
+        out.append(line)
+        people = [p for p in sp.get("people") or [] if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("name")]
+        out += [f"  named by the source: {p['name']}" + (f" ({p['role']})" if p.get("role") else "")
+                + (f': "{_cut(p["line"], 140)}"' if p.get("line") else "") for p in people] or \
+            ["  the source names nobody"]
+    text = "\n".join(out)
+    if len(text) > SPEAKERS_MAX:
+        text = text[:SPEAKERS_MAX - 14].rsplit("\n", 1)[0] + "\n- (truncated)"
+    return text.split("\n") if text else []
+
+

+                       {"name": "Jason Hickel", "role": "guest", "line": "a debate with Jason Hickel"}]}},
+        {"role": "clip", "channel": "What Bitcoin Did", "speaker": {

+            "people": [{"name": "Patrick Witt", "role": "guest", "line": "title: Patrick Witt on the strategic reserve"}]}},
+        {"role": "clip", "channel": "Natalie Brunell", "speaker": {"name": "unknown", "people": []}}]}
+
+    def test_order_0005_the_sealed_speakers_are_in_the_review_note(self):
+        self._write("PINNED_DECISION.json", {"pin": self.SPEAKER_PIN})
+        T.review_drop(self.run, send=self._send)
+        note = self.sent[-1][2]["text"]
+        self.assertIn(T.SPEAKERS_HEAD, note)
+        self.assertIn("- hook (Saifedean Ammous): speaker unknown (several people speak and nothing shows which one)", note)
+        self.assertIn('  named by the source: Jason Hickel (guest): "a debate with Jason Hickel"', note)
+        self.assertIn('- clip 1 (What Bitcoin Did): speaker Patrick Witt (guest), evidence: "title: Patrick Witt on the '
+                      'strategic reserve"', note)
+        self.assertIn("- clip 2 (Natalie Brunell): speaker unknown\n  the source names nobody", note)
+
+    def test_order_0005_a_pin_without_speaker_records_adds_no_block(self):
+        T.review_drop(self.run, send=self._send)
+        self.assertNotIn(T.SPEAKERS_HEAD, self.sent[-1][2]["text"])
+
+    def test_order_0005_a_huge_speaker_record_is_capped_and_never_blocks_the_drop(self):
+        big = {"segments": [{"channel": "Saifedean Ammous", "speaker": {"name": "unknown", "why": "w" * 5000, "people": [
+            {"name": f"Person {i}", "line": "x" * 500} for i in range(40)]}}]}
+        self._write("PINNED_DECISION.json", {"pin": big})
+        T.review_drop(self.run, send=self._send)
+        note = self.sent[-1][2]["text"]
+        block = note[note.index(T.SPEAKERS_HEAD):]
+        self.assertIn("- (truncated)", block)
+        self.assertLessEqual(len(note), T.TEXT_MAX)
+
+    def test_order_0005_the_publish_kit_carries_the_sealed_speakers(self):
+        self._write("PINNED_DECISION.json", {"pin": self.SPEAKER_PIN})
+        kit = T.publish_kit(self.run)
+        self.assertIn(T.SPEAKERS_HEAD, kit)
+        self.assertLess(kit.index(T.SPEAKERS_HEAD), kit.index("FIRST COMMENT:"))
+        self.assertIn("speaker Patrick Witt (guest)", kit)
+
